scope_label: Validator-Only Local Synthetic Scope (No Live/Customer Data)
methodology: Single local sequential run: 100 valid full-response checks followed by 100 mutant response checks, 25 per mutation class. perf_counter_ns per call, perf_counter wall duration. Linear-interpolated percentiles over the mixed 200-call sample. No warmup/randomization/replicate or controlled hardware comparison.
